scene: The giant cat purrs, spinning to reveal a neon secret corridor.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along the glowing arcade floor. Far left sits an open hover-tram on glowing rails. Center stands the Pacific Islander man with top knot, floral shirt and ukulele. Midair at the centre flutters a golden ticket. Far right, the rotated lucky cat reveals an open doorway full of blue neon.
shown: a doorway glowing with blue neon inside the rotated cat statue on the right
a golden ticket fluttering from the cat mouth, suspended midair at the centre
a mini hover-tram waiting with open doors on rails at the far left
